security_boundaries: snapshot write uses org GUC transaction
global snapshot version is explicit GLOBAL_SHARED identity
tenant_boundaries: collectState filters caller org or legacy NULL
freshness comparison uses snapshot org when caller lacks org
self-effect assignment/reservation reads are now tenant scoped

findings.evidence: assertFreshForWave selected own dispatched assignments and reservations by planId only.
findings.impact: A same-shaped planId in another tenant could be treated as this plan’s self-effect, masking real external drift and allowing dispatch from a stale world state.
findings.fix: Scoped assignment and reservation self-effect reads to caller/snapshot org with explicit legacy NULL compatibility, then added cross-tenant wave regression.

findings.evidence: latestPersistedSnapshotVersion selects exact org or NULL and does not fall back across lineage.
findings.impact: An org with only legacy global snapshots sees a placeholder read-only snapshot version rather than a legacy version.
findings.fix: Keep explicit behavior until data migration defines global snapshot inheritance; placeholder is not fabricated as tenant fact.

contracts: same-planId other-org dispatched effect is not stripped
external task drift still raises PLAN_STALE
tenant_boundaries: org1 caller cannot inherit org2 same-plan self-effect

findings.evidence: No regression covered another tenant sharing a planId during wave freshness checks.
findings.impact: Unsafe stripping of cross-tenant self-effects was invisible.
findings.fix: Added row-level fake that strips only org1 task and proves org2 task drift rejects with PLAN_STALE.
